audit.why: 52.25% over 2088 games at 6/10: Lucian owns the first two levels, the middle is a positioning war, Gangplank takes over from Sheen. That is what the prose says.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts gave Levels 2 and 3 to Gangplank and called Level 1 'Skill'. The packet chart says Lucian/Lucian/Skill, and the page's own whys agree — whys[0] says his double-shot out-trades your autos and pops your barrels, whys[1] says 'he out-ranges your raw autos in the levels 1-3 window'.
audit.why: Telling a Gangplank he wins levels 2-3 against a Lucian who out-ranges him is how the lane gets lost.
audit.corrected: win[0], win[1], win[2] and phases[0..2].side/.rating/.why brought onto the packet chart as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer says to 'cleanse the Relentless Pursuit setup' — Relentless Pursuit is a dash, there is nothing on it to cleanse. It also never gives its real behaviour: 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, and Lightslinger attacks REDUCE that cooldown, so it comes back faster the longer a trade runs. Ardent Blaze (900 range) marks you and grants him move speed for attacking marked targets, which is never mentioned at all.
audit.why: 'Bait it, then commit' is only correct if you know the cooldown shrinks while he is hitting you — the window after a spent dash is shorter than a flat 16 seconds.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, report[0], report[1], enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and dosFull[0] rebuilt on the real numbers.

audit.why: The missing-interactions file asks for anti-heal against 'Lightslinger (P)', but Riot's own passive text describes Lucian being healed or shielded BY AN ALLY as a trigger for bonus damage — it is not a heal Lucian applies. I did not add an anti-heal line on the strength of a parsed flag that contradicts the description.

notes: The missing-interactions file asks for anti-heal here on the strength of a heal flag on Lightslinger, but Riot's passive text says Lucian getting healed or shielded BY AN ALLY triggers bonus damage — he is not the healer. I treated that as a tooltip-parsing misfire and did not write an anti-heal line. The real unstated mechanic is that Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown, which changes how long the post-dash window actually lasts. packet.suspectNames flagged 'Powder Kegs' and 'Hold Relentless Pursuit': both false positives.
